title: Cell Cycle: Phases, Organization and Biological Significance
method: Whitespace-delimited visible theory prose excluding headings, diagrams, tables, questions, references and UI. Article total includes headings, captions, tables and practice but excludes SVG and controls.
comparator: 2.C.03: 7564 narrative words; 2.C.10: 8610; 2.B.10: 9074. Reviewed all 15 teaching sections against approved narrower phase-organization scope, not a word quota.
scientific_checks: Official merged CSIR–UGC–DBT NET Unit 2.D page 3 and archived MP SET 2024 page 2 visually verified. Reviewed G1/S/G2/M/G0, phase order, quiescence and differentiation, ploidy and C/Cx conventions, anaphase compartment counting, partial S, pulse–chase, Howard/Pelc and Rao/Johnson evidence, flow cytometry ambiguity, endocycle, population fractions, exponential age distribution and original practice. Recalculated all eight worked examples and quantitative practice: 12/24; 6.4/12.8 pg and 50%; 75%; 58/27/15/4/11%; 9/7/3/1 h; 58.6%; 1600 and 3200C; 2.5/10% and 1.6 h; practice 8 pg, 4 pg, 75%, 15%, 2000/4000C, 58.6%, 1.2 h. Second review clarified reference genome and added trajectory reasoning.
limitations: Author performed a separate examiner-role self-review; no independent human academic reviewer or interactive browser/device rendering/accessibility audit. Official MPPSC-hosted current SET syllabus not located; archived 2024 comparator used. Pages verification pending. Next chapter not linked while unpublished.
